title: Fluctuation Magnetoconductance in MgB2
abstract: We report fluctuation magnetoconductance in a MgB2 superconductor prepared under a high pressure of 3 GPa. This excess magnetoconductance, $Δσ(H)$, follows the three-dimensional scaling function for the critical fluctuations proposed by Ullah and Dorsey. This feature is inferred to originate from the isotropic nature of the MgB2 compound.
